description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling endpoint discovery configurations. It includes methods for creating configuration providers based on environment variables, INI files, fallback logic, and chaining multiple providers. The class manages caching and promise-based asynchronous configuration retrieval.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides methods for creating and managing endpoint discovery configurations, supporting environment variables, INI files, fallback options, caching, and chaining of multiple providers.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider, checking environment variables, shared config files, and defaults, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on environment variables for endpoint discovery.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options based on service model data or default values.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads configuration from an INI file, optionally specified by profile and filename.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a configuration object (promise, array, or config instance) into a ConfigurationInterface instance.
